s01_era.text: Scene: the last winter dusk of an age, on a narrow cobbled lane in the lower city of a great tower-city, the lane's bakery door standing open. In the lower middle of the picture, at the lane's mouth, a bakery oven door glows orange and throws the only warm light on the wet stones. Around it stand a few tiny, simply drawn people: a broad, round-bellied baker with ash in his ginger hair and a flat wooden peel on his shoulder; a small copper-haired girl holding a little brass lamp; a tall slim night-demon girl with a long black braid, swept-back horns and a candle stub on a thread at her neck; and a lanky young scholar in an oversized cloak hugging a roll of papers. The whole top half of the picture is filled with the city's great radiant towers, pale layered silhouettes with thin bright edges, rising row behind row higher than the frame, all just beginning to lean. Behind and between them, from dark cracks in the ground, enormous pale shadow-figures are beginning to stand, taller than the towers, their heads turned down toward the little lane. One long S-shaped column of smoke climbs from the oven chimney and melts into the towers. The bottom quarter is only dark cobbles. Palette: bone white and cold slate blue-grey, a trace of pale gold on the tower edges, deep dry-red in the cracks, oven orange only in the fire.
s01_era.note: 元年黄昏初光街，炉门是唯一的暖光；塔刚要歪、影子刚要站起，砸落留给节点。环心小背影放得很远很小，不想要可删。

s02_era.text: Scene: early spring dusk on a wide plain of grey ash outside the ruins of a great city, the ash lying knee deep and, in the air above it, hanging in a faint motionless haze. In the lower middle of the picture a small campfire burns in a hollow dug into the ash, with a few tiny people around it: a lanky young scholar in an oversized cloak crouched over a sheet of paper; a stocky older man with a satchel of scroll cases; and a young woman holding a half-burnt manuscript close to her chest. The top half is filled with the great fallen spires of the old tower grove, lying across the plain in pale layered silhouettes with thin bright edges, each longer than a mountain ridge. Far right, one tall tower hangs crooked from a cliff, a single lamp still lit at its tip. On the far western horizon a few small red camp fires of the demon people glimmer. One long S-shaped column of smoke rises from the campfire and fades into the fallen towers. The bottom quarter is only dark, soft ash. Palette: ash grey, slate blue-grey and bone white, faint dry-red on the western horizon, one touch of pale gold on the crooked tower's lamp, fire orange only in the campfire.
s02_era.note: 元年次春，灰悬在半空不落；歪塔顶灯、西边魔族营火都留作远处细节。

s03_era.text: Scene: a cold autumn night in a half-mad wheat field on the south bank of a northern river, the wheat grown taller than a man, its ears hung with white frost and its stalks tangled with horned vines. In the lower middle of the picture a small camp fire burns in a trampled clearing among the wheat, with a few tiny clusters of people around it: a white-haired night-healer woman with short polished horns, bent over a bundle of herbs; a broad-shouldered flame-horned man with a lit tip on each horn; a grim young scout with a spear. Their horns each carry a small flame, so the clearing is dotted with tiny lights. In the far east edge of the field, three small separate banners on three distant ridges stand against the dusk. The whole top half is filled with a colossal layered shadow that rises from the western horizon behind the wheat: a hunched giant crowned with many short straight horns like spikes, seated on a throne of black stone, drawn as pale overlapping silhouettes with thin bright edges, so tall that its head is above the frame, turned downward over the camp. One long S-shaped column of smoke from the camp fire rises and merges into its dark shoulder. The bottom quarter is only dark wheat stalks. Palette: iron grey and frost blue-grey, dry dark red on the western silhouettes, bone white frost, flame orange only in the camp fire and the horn tips.
s03_era.note: 44年秋夜，霜河南岸；上面画的是西边抬头的魔神侧影（泛指，不点哪一尊）。四十来人只画几簇。

s04_era.text: Scene: an autumn dusk inside the old walled city of the White Crown, where a fallen radiant tower of pale stone lies across the whole width of the central square and the houses have been built round it. In the lower middle of the picture, on a stone ledge of the west wall, a beacon fire burns in an iron basket. Around it stand a few tiny, simply drawn figures: a tall knight in bright silver plate armor seen from behind, his whole head enclosed in a closed great helm shaped like a lion's head, so that no hair, no face and no skin can be seen at all, a long white fur-collared cloak hanging from his shoulders and a sword longer than a man held point-down; a broad-shouldered knight in a worn blue surcoat; and an old dwarf with a hammer on his shoulder. The top half is filled with two vast layers: the fallen tower, a long pale silhouette like a stone bridge across the sky, and above and behind it, rolling in from the west over the wall, an immense host of horned demon people in dark red layered silhouettes with thin bright edges, every horn tip burning. They advance toward the small fire. One long S-shaped column of smoke from the beacon climbs into the fallen tower. The bottom quarter is only dark paving stones. Palette: iron grey and steel blue-grey, deep dry-red across the western host, bone white armor edges, flame orange only in the beacon and the horn tips.
s04_era.note: 172年秋白冠城，诺伦只画背影闭盔；魔潮是背后的灯阵。倒下的辉塔横在广场上，是页上写的。

s05_era.text: Scene: a bright spring morning on the rolling mead hills of the halfling country, small hills with round green doors, windmills turning on the ridges and bee-hives hung beside every door. In the lower middle of the picture a halfling cart with a round canvas hood has stopped on a dirt track before a hillside door, a small cooking fire burning beside it. Around the fire are a few tiny, simply drawn people: a plump halfling woman with a ladle; a tall slim elf in a green cloak leaning on a long staff; and a knight in white-trimmed silver armor standing beside the cart with his back to us, his whole head enclosed in a closed great helm shaped like a lion's head, so that no hair, no face and no skin can be seen at all, the helm tilted toward the door. The top half is filled with seven enormous closed doors standing one behind another in the sky over the hills, drawn as pale overlapping silhouettes with thin bright edges: a door of woven living branches, a door of cut stone with a dwarf rune plate, a round door like the halfling hillside door, and a rough, lopsided door of black iron. Each has a small keyhole of pale gold light. They look down toward the cart. One long S-shaped column of smoke rises and winds between the doors. The bottom quarter is only dark furrows of earth. Palette: soft green-grey and slate blue-grey, bone white, pale gold in the keyholes, a touch of dull red on the iron door, fire orange only in the cooking fire.
s05_era.note: 180年春蜜酒丘陵；七扇门画在天上，七个族的风格各一，最末一扇是魔族的。皇帝闭盔背身，坐半身人的车。

s06_era.text: Scene: a cold autumn dusk on a long bare ridge crowned by a small stone fortress at the far western end of a campaign, the old woods on the ridge full of black crows lifting in thousands. In the lower middle of the picture a watch fire burns inside the fortress courtyard, with a few tiny, simply drawn people around it: an emperor in silver plate armor on a tired white horse, seen from behind, his whole head enclosed in a closed great helm shaped like a lion's head, so that no hair, no face and no skin can be seen at all, his great sword hanging at the saddle; a young soldier and a hooded horned soldier sitting side by side at the fire, one with a gold-hilted knife at his belt and the other with a knife of plain iron; a lean dragonkin with folded wings and blue scales on his cheeks. The top half is filled by seven true dragons descending slowly from the clouds, drawn as pale overlapping silhouettes with thin bright edges, each larger than the ridge, wings spread one behind another like successive ranges of mountains, heads lowered toward the little fire, and before them a vast flock of crows forming a dark layered cloud that spirals up around their wings. One long S-shaped column of smoke from the watch fire climbs into the wing of the nearest dragon. The bottom quarter is only dark stone and dead leaves. Palette: iron grey and steel blue-grey, bone white dragon edges, faint dry-red toward the west horizon, a little pale gold on the gold-hilted knife, fire orange only in the watch fire.
s06_era.note: 229年秋鸦岭，西征第三十年；七头真龙从云上下来（龙是西式的）。金刀与铁刀放在魔族老人膝上，属拿不准的象征。

s07_era.text: Scene: a spring afternoon on a vast, bare stretch of land at the north end of a great foundation trench, the trench cut straight south to the vanishing point and its bottom packed hard. In the lower middle of the picture a small iron brazier burns on the trench's edge, and around it a few tiny, simply drawn people from six peoples: an old dwarf with a hammer; a tall elf in a pale cloak; a young man with a surveyor's rod; a hooded shadow-demon youth standing a little apart; and a lean dragonkin with folded wings. Beside them an emperor in silver armor stands with his back to us, his whole head enclosed in a closed great helm shaped like a lion's head, so that no hair, no face and no skin can be seen at all. The top half is filled with towering pale heaps of white stone blocks and timber scaffolds, drawn as layered silhouettes with thin bright edges, rising like a mountain range along the whole length of the trench, with only the lowest course knee-high at the left. Over them a single true dragon circles, huge and pale, its shadow falling across the stone. One long S-shaped column of smoke rises from the brazier and drifts into the scaffolds. The bottom quarter is only dark packed earth. Palette: steel blue-grey and stone grey, bone white stone edges, a little pale gold on the dragon, dull red only on the far western sky, fire orange only in the brazier.
s07_era.note: 233年春开工，墙还没立：上面画的是堆成山的白石、脚手架、车队和一头龙，不画合龙的墙。

s08_era.text: Scene: a spring dusk at a gap in the middle of a great white stone wall, the thaw seeping up from beneath the foundation and a half-mended stretch of masonry beside it. In the lower middle of the picture a small iron brazier burns on a platform at the gap, with a few tiny, simply drawn people: a stout mason with a hammer by a wagon of fresh white stone; a hooded shadow-demon in a long cloak, tired, standing at the edge; and a tall elf with a long staff scoring a mark on a post. Hanging all along the wall behind them, in long rows, are pale antlers, one for every year, hundreds of them. The top half is filled with the vast white wall itself rising out of the dusk, drawn as pale overlapping silhouettes with thin bright edges, tower behind tower stretching to the horizon, and from every tower and rampart hang more antlers in layered tiers, thicker and thicker toward the sky until they form a pale forest of branching shapes. One long S-shaped column of smoke from the brazier rises into the antler forest. The bottom quarter is only dark wet mud and white stone chips. Palette: slate blue-grey and iron grey, bone white wall and antlers, dull dry-red on the western glow, fire orange only in the brazier.
s08_era.note: 341年春中段那处口子，长垒已合龙；鹿角一年一根，往上越挂越密。火边是斯滕家守口子的人。

s09_era.text: Scene: an autumn morning in the courtyard of a new school in a walled town behind the southern part of a great wall, a long low hall behind a lit lamp on a post. In the lower middle of the picture a small hearth fire burns under a lamp-hung porch, and around it a few tiny, simply drawn people: an old, broad-shouldered soldier with a limp, carrying a stone tablet under one arm; a girl of seventeen in a plain coat with a satchel; a nineteen-year-old halfling with an ink bottle on a cord; and a horned demon girl of sixteen with her horns uncovered, standing a little apart with a borrowed book. The top half is filled with a mountain of upright stone tablets rising behind the town, drawn as pale overlapping silhouettes with thin bright edges, slab behind slab and cliff behind cliff, each as tall as a tower and covered with fine rows of ruled lines, so that they look like the strata of a stone library, and behind them the enormous white wall crossing the whole sky. One long S-shaped column of smoke rises from the hearth and merges into the tablets. The bottom quarter is only dark cobbles. Palette: stone grey and slate blue-grey, bone white tablets, pale gold in the lamp, dry dull red only on the far southern shadow, fire orange only in the hearth.
s09_era.note: 977年秋战法学院开门；上面是堆成山的石板（格尔贝特刻满一屋子的放大）。石板上不写字，只画细线。

s10_era.text: Scene: a high summer afternoon on the grassy slope at the very southern end of a great wall, where the wall simply stops and the land falls away to a gentle meadow of knee-high grass. In the lower middle of the picture a small shepherd's fire burns beside a stone sheepfold, with a few tiny, simply drawn people: an old woman in a grey wool coat leaning on a stick; a young soldier with a long spear. On the last stretch of the wall behind them stands a small, plain temple with its doors facing south. The top half is filled by an immense standing figure of a shield god, an armored giant who strides to the very end of the wall and plants a tower-sized shield before himself, facing south, drawn as pale layered silhouettes with thin bright edges in steel and bone white, with only a thin pale gold on the shield rim and no halo round his head; behind him a whole host of tiny soldiers gathers within the shield's shadow. In the far south, a vast dark shape rises above the horizon, rank behind rank of horned silhouettes in dry red. One long S-shaped column of smoke from the shepherd's fire climbs to the shield rim. The bottom quarter is only dark grass. Palette: steel blue-grey and green-grey, bone white shield, pale gold on the rim, dry dark red in the south, fire orange only in the shepherd's fire.
s10_era.note: 1020年夏南段最南头；上面是举盾的神立在墙头，对面南边是魔神的轮廓，两边都不画细部。正神无光环。

s11_era.text: Scene: a spring night on a street of forges at the foot of a great ridge, the street split down the middle: on the west side human workshops, on the east side dwarf workshops, forge fires facing each other across the cobbles. In the lower middle of the picture the two forge fires glow on either side of the street, with a few tiny, simply drawn people between them: a stocky half-dwarf woman with a long-spouted bronze bellows on her back; an old dwarf with a leather apron and a huge hammer; a fifteen-year-old beast-eared boy carrying a coal basket; and a young apprentice with a pair of tongs. The top half is filled with the ridge above the street, drawn as pale layered silhouettes with thin bright edges, and cut into it a colossal cold furnace, a great round mouth in the rock as wide as a lake, with giant pipes and iron stairs descending like the ribs of a hill, row on row, the whole mass looking down on the little street. One long S-shaped column of smoke climbs from the east forge and another from the west, and the two twist together into one and disappear into the furnace mouth. The bottom quarter is only dark soot-black cobbles. Palette: iron grey and slate blue-grey, bone white edges, dry dull red in the furnace depths, fire orange only in the two forges.
s11_era.note: 1192年春对炉街，街西人族街东矮人；上面是熔铁炉心的大炉口，不画神杀炮（3046）。炮管写成魔晶炮，不是火药炮。

s12_era.text: Scene: a spring dusk on a vast golden plain of winter wheat, the green stalks just reaching the calf, an open pillared shrine standing alone in the field, four stone pillars under a straw roof, no walls. In the lower middle of the picture a small bread oven burns in front of the shrine, with a few tiny, simply drawn people: a round halfling woman carrying a basket of round loaves; a nineteen-year-old girl with a sickle and a young beast-eared girl with a gleaner's sack. The top half is filled by the gods going south, drawn as pale overlapping silhouettes with thin bright edges and no halos: a long procession of colossal robed and armored figures, each taller than a hill, walking one behind another across the whole sky from the north toward the south, their backs to us, none turning, the nearest one's cloak sweeping across the frame. At the edge of the field one tiny knight in white-trimmed silver armor stands with his back to us, his whole head enclosed in a closed great helm shaped like a lion's head, so that no hair, no face and no skin can be seen at all, watching them go. One long S-shaped column of smoke from the oven rises and merges into the procession. The bottom quarter is only dark furrows. Palette: soft slate blue-grey and wheat grey-green, bone white figures, pale gold on their hems, a touch of dull red in the far south, fire orange only in the oven.
s12_era.note: 1790年春金穗平原；正神一位接一位往南走，都背对画面。皇帝在这一段交冠南去，只画一个闭盔小背影。

s13_era.text: Scene: an autumn night on the grey-green grass at the northern edge of the dead land, the plain ahead lit with faint rust-red flowers blooming wherever iron lies. In the lower middle of the picture a forge brazier burns beside a huge dwarf-forged bronze cannon on a many-wheeled carriage, its barrel as long as a ship and carved from breech to muzzle with fine lines of runes, its muzzle raised to the south, with a few tiny, simply drawn people around it: a seventy-year-old dwarf woman with a ramrod; a very old bearded dwarf with a big wrench; a halfling woman with a water bucket; a hooded demon man with his hands raised in refusal, standing beside them. The top half is filled with a colossal layered silhouette that rises from the southern haze: a vast giant whose body is like a breached wall, broad as a ridge, with two short straight horns standing upright on its head like the square towers of a gate, drawn as pale overlapping silhouettes with thin bright edges, hunched forward and looking down toward the little cannon. Far off on the left of the sky one tiny winged white horse with a rider crosses, the only other thing in the sky. One long S-shaped column of smoke from the brazier rises toward the giant's chest. The bottom quarter is only dark grass and rusty flowers. Palette: iron grey and slate blue-grey, rust dry-red on the flowers and the horizon, bone white edges, pale gold on the far winged horse, fire orange only in the brazier.
s13_era.note: 3046年秋死域北沿，神杀炮刚架好、还没响。上面是拆墙者拜恩的侧影（页上这时他还没断角没瞎眼）。炮写成魔晶炮。

s14_era.text: Scene: an autumn night on a rounded hill in the line of frontier camps along the edge of the dead land, a beacon tower on the summit and two rings of white stone wall below it. In the lower middle of the picture the beacon basket burns on the tower's foot, with a few tiny, simply drawn people around it: a sixty-seven-year-old quartermaster with a ledger; a sixteen-year-old girl with a signal flag; another girl of sixteen with a short sword on her back; a lean forty-year-old captain with a scarf. The top half is filled with a line of colossal steam-driven war machines standing shoulder to shoulder on the ridge to the south, drawn as pale overlapping silhouettes with thin bright edges, each as tall as a hill, with domed heads, boiler chests and stubby clawed arms, row behind row to the horizon, all dark and unmoving, and above them a sky crossed by the tall roots of towers not yet risen, pale stone shafts standing on the dead plain. One long S-shaped column of smoke from the beacon rises and winds up between the machines. The bottom quarter is only dark packed earth. Palette: iron grey and slate blue-grey, bone white edges, dull dry-red in the south, a little pale gold along the tower shafts, fire orange only in the beacon.
s14_era.note: 4601年秋死域边的营垒；上面是蒸汽机甲列队（约4200年起有），塔还没浮起来（约5300），只画立在地上的塔根。

s15_era.text: Scene: a dusk of early spring on a vast flat high plain, the grass short and the horizon endless, a single flat-topped black mesa with cliffs cut sheer rising from its center, and at its foot a great plain altar of red stone. In the lower middle of the picture a small fire burns at the edge of a camp that runs from horizon to horizon in thousands of tents, with a few tiny, simply drawn people beside it: a ten-year-old child with a long braid sitting on a barrel; a tall demon woman with dark red eyes, the cup in her hand turned upside down; a broad flame-horned demon man with an armful of firewood. The top half is filled with an enormous seated shadow on the top of the mesa, drawn as pale overlapping silhouettes with thin bright edges, a vast hunched figure whose outline is made of countless wolf shapes, packs of them stacked one over another, lowering its head toward the camps. One long S-shaped column of smoke from the camp fire climbs and splits into the wolf shapes. The bottom quarter is only dark short grass. Palette: iron grey and slate blue-grey, deep dry-red on the altar and the camp banners, bone white edges, pale gold on a single far ridge, fire orange only in the camp fire.
s15_era.note: 6720年春万角原血誓的宴；高座上的魔神画成许多狼叠成的坐像（近看一群兽）。祭台只写红石，不画碗里的东西。

s16_era.text: Scene: a spring night at a cracked stretch of the southern wall, the foundations loosened by the thaw, a small mending shed built against the wall's foot with mortar buckets and a heap of stone. In the lower middle of the picture a small lamp fire burns inside the shed's doorway, with a few tiny, simply drawn people: a sixteen-year-old tiefling girl with small horns and a trowel; a stout, one-hundred-sixty-year-old dwarf woman with a heavy mallet; a group of young masons holding a pale pennant on a pole; a lean captain with a plumb line. The top half is filled with a column of floating towers drifting south over the dead land, drawn as pale layered silhouettes with thin bright edges, one behind another, each a stone spire riding on a great rock of floating earth with roots hanging, getting smaller toward the horizon, the nearest tower filling the sky above the wall, and the lowest of them sinking slowly toward the south. Far to the south a dull red glow lies along the whole horizon. One long S-shaped column of smoke from the lamp fire climbs and fades into the nearest tower. The bottom quarter is only dark wet stone and mud. Palette: iron grey and slate blue-grey, bone white towers, pale gold on the edges of the nearest tower, dry dark red along the southern horizon, fire orange only in the lamp fire.
s16_era.note: 约7672年春南七段补墙；浮塔成列往南漂（约5300起有）。远处小圆日轮是三枚日轮的伏笔，只画一个小圆，不画碎。

s17_era.text: Scene: an autumn dusk on the south section of a great wall, where the wall runs north across grey-green grass and stands on a long arched bridge over a river as wide as a strait, three stone bridges carrying the roads behind it. In the lower middle of the picture a small camp fire burns in a clearing near the wall's foot, with six tiny, simply drawn people of six peoples around it and one place at the fire left empty: a dark-skinned elf woman with a quiver; a nineteen-year-old human with a sword; a squat dwarf with a hammer; a halfling with a pack; a young tiefling with small horns; and a half-orc with a spear. The top half is filled with a colossal horned giant walking out of the dead land's haze toward the wall, drawn as pale overlapping silhouettes with thin bright edges, its two short straight horns standing upright like the square towers of a gate, both whole, hands the size of towers hanging open, the wall's pale arches and dozens of small walled towns behind it spread out beneath its shadow, every town's light a small point. One long S-shaped column of smoke from the camp fire rises and merges into the giant's chest. The bottom quarter is only dark grass. Palette: slate blue-grey and iron grey, bone white arches, deep dry-red on the giant, a little pale gold on the town lights, fire orange only in the camp fire.
s17_era.note: 9318年秋南段，七柱碑以前；上面是出死域的拜恩，断左角瞎右眼（页上9318年以后的样子，不画胸口的火）。七个人各一族，站得散。

s18_era.text: Scene: an autumn dusk behind the southernmost town of the great wall, the fields just harvested and plowed for winter wheat, the dead land just beyond the wall. In the lower middle of the picture a small fire burns at the edge of a plowed field, with a few tiny, simply drawn people: a beast-eared girl of eighteen with a coil of rope; and a seventy-four-year-old dwarf with a huge wrench, standing beside a short clockwork soldier with a brass key in its back, parked at his feet. The top half is filled with a colossal war machine standing on a stone platform higher than the town walls, drawn as pale overlapping silhouettes with thin bright edges, a man-shaped armoured giant standing upright on two legs like a colossal knight, with a plain round helmet for a head and no beast's face, its layered armor plates carved with fine leaf patterns and edged with rows of small scales, taller than the ridge beyond the wall, its helmeted head lowered toward the little fire, its heart a furnace-glow of dull orange deep in its belly. Behind it, on the dim edge of the dead land, a long line of small clockwork soldiers marches south with keys on their backs. One long S-shaped column of smoke from the fire rises and merges into the giant's shoulder plates. The bottom quarter is only dark plowed earth. Palette: iron grey and slate blue-grey, bone white plates, a little pale gold on the dragon scales, dry dull red on the horizon, fire orange only in the fire and the machine's belly.
s18_era.note: 9801年秋第一台擎天级立起来的那天，台基在段城墙后；背后远处是发条机兵（背上钥匙）和铁狼，都是8800年后才有，对得上。

s19_era.text: Scene: the brightest summer day of the whole age, in a small wall-town beside the southern wall, a strip of wheat growing at the foot of the wall. In the lower middle of the picture a small cooking fire burns at the town's south gate, with four tiny, simply drawn travelers: a tall young man with blue hair and a flaxen cloak over a blue tunic, a plain single-handed sword at his hip; a man with short green hair, square spectacles and a white priest's robe with narrow gold edging; a short, stout dwarf with a horned helm, a long red cape and a huge axe; and a slim silver-haired elf woman with two long tails of hair, holding a staff. The top half is filled with the dead land's edge to the south, and rising from it a colossal hooded giant, drawn as pale overlapping silhouettes with thin bright edges, and in the middle of its chest a tall narrow tear, long and ragged like a rip in cloth and not round at all, through which plain pale daylight shows, and behind it the ground simply stops, with no road. It looks down at the little wall-town. One long S-shaped column of smoke from the fire rises into the giant's cloak. The bottom quarter is only dark wall stones and green wheat. Palette: bone white and pale cold sky blue-grey, slate grey, pale gold in the chest light, a faint dry-red only in the far south, fire orange only in the cooking fire.
s19_era.note: 10899年夏；全纪最亮的白天。上面是兜帽、胸口透白光的魔神（亚蒙）轮廓。四位旅人照辛美尔小队原作长相。注意写了「蓝发」，不写他叫什么。

s20_era.text: Scene: a spring dusk on a wide salt flat on the northern shore of a dark sea, the ebbing tide leaving layers of dull red salt crystals and a row of seven empty stone fortresses standing along the shore, the first six with their gates wide open and the seventh shut. In the lower middle of the picture a small salt-pan lantern fire burns on a plank pier, with a few tiny, simply drawn people: a nineteen-year-old sea-demon girl with fin-like ears and a net; a twenty-two-year-old human woman with a letter case on a strap. Far out on the flat, in the empty space between two thin dark lines of waiting soldiers, a tiny plain woman walks with her back to us, no glow around her. The top half is filled by a vast wave-shaped giant rising out of the sea, drawn as pale overlapping silhouettes with thin bright edges, a mass of layered, murky water standing up like a cliff with a faint hooded face, its shadow falling across the shore. One long S-shaped column of smoke from the lantern fire climbs and melts into the wave. The bottom quarter is only dark wet sand. Palette: iron grey and slate blue-grey, deep dry-red on the salt and the horizon, bone white fortress edges, a little pale gold in the sky, fire orange only in the lantern fire.
s20_era.note: 10992年春盐海北岸老滩，七座空营垒前六座敞门；上面画的是浊水的魔神（威沛）立起一座水崖。女人很小背影，不画神光，放得很远。

s21_era.text: Scene: a grey spring dawn rain falling on a small town at the foot of a great white wall, the town ringed by a low waist-high wall of fallen white stone with two gates, one facing the wall road and one facing the fields. In the lower middle of the picture, in the open south gateway, a small hearth fire burns in a stone ring under the arch, and beside it an empty wicker basket with a folded cloth rests on the stone, no child shown. A few tiny, simply drawn people stand about in the rain: a fifty-year-old woman gatekeeper with a lantern; a man with a satchel, hood up; and a sixty-year-old mason with a chisel and mallet. The top half is filled with the great wall itself rising out of the rain, drawn as pale layered silhouettes with thin bright edges, tower behind tower to the vanishing point, with rows of great war horns mounted on its battlements, and along its foot a line of colossal war machines standing silent and idle, drawn as the same grey silhouettes. One long S-shaped column of smoke from the gateway fire climbs through the rain and thins into the grey. The bottom quarter is only dark wet cobbles. Palette: rain grey and slate blue-grey, bone white wall edges, a trace of rust dry-red on the horns, faint pale gold at the lightening sky, fire orange only in the gateway fire.
s21_era.note: 11034年春灰雨城南门洞；篮子只画篮子，不画婴儿。墙上挂的号角、停着的擎天级是第七页写的。人物里没画孩子，迪特里希/玛蒂尔德用叫法代替。
